result.summary: Found 2 issues: a pizza promo card showing a meaningless -0% badge, and a restaurant name truncated in the fastest-near-you row.

issues.description: The pizza card displays a '-0%' badge, which is not a meaningful discount and looks like a data or formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the value is 0%, or show a real promotion/price instead of a zero-off label.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' restaurant name is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines or truncate with an ellipsis so the name is not abruptly clipped.
